# Multivariate matched-control designs

TokenJunkieLabs scientific engineering for the original Upper Savannah Workspace.
Current workflow: WO-19, ECO-MULTIVARIATE-CONTROLS-20261013. Original scientific method choices and interpretation remain with the prime.

## What the complete workflow does

Select an original baseline native run and an exact retained restoration footprint. Declare source-unit covariate boundaries and, optionally, an acceptance threshold for the prepared runoff proxy. The original exact one-dimensional Monge matcher selects distinct off-treatment control cells within each admitted original-class/covariate stratum. Save the full assessment, inspect remaining balance and missing support, and adopt an accepted design through the original source, scenario, native run and experiment writers.

The original baseline/restoration selections remain immutable. A different design gets its own saved ID, source collection, scenario, run and original experiment. Executing that original experiment reuses completed original cases; the control is the new native case. This module never replaces NDR/SDR, the original experiment queue or an existing control.

### Exact scientific scope

* The treatment population is every actual final baseline-to-restoration changed cell in the selected compiled footprint. A completed restoration must agree, cell for cell and support for support, with its retained native land-cover stage. A current compiler preview cannot silently replace an executed treatment.
* A successful design retains the entire original treatment count and from/to transition roster. Every treatment cell must lie in the original reporting mask and have every selected admission covariate. Missing support produces an unaccepted assessment; it does not shrink the design.
* Candidates are unchanged original cells inside the same reporting mask, of an original treatment class, outside the actual treatment and outside the optional explicit exclusion mask. Unknown exclusion support is excluded. Each control cell is used once.
* This first edition admits one destination code per original class. A treatment that changes one original class to competing destination classes is rejected explicitly before adoption; no independent matcher may reuse their shared candidate pool.
* Native DEM, R_FACTOR, K_FACTOR and PRECIPITATION values are the already-aligned and converted prepared grid. Their original source entries, classifications, source SHA, units, conversion and resampling history remain in input-binding.json. Conversion is not applied a second time.
* Optional SLOPE and CONNECTIVITY are explicitly chosen original single-band rasters on the exact native shape, CRS and affine transform. The analyst supplies real units and a physical definition. An unapplied conversion is rejected; select its original prepared output instead. DEM means elevation, not slope. A connectivity label alone never defines its physical quantity.
* Stratum boundaries are exact analyst-authored values. Bins are lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive, with unbounded outer bins; an exact edge enters the higher bin. An empty boundary list is one unconstrained bin and is labeled that way.
* The unchanged original matcher minimizes total absolute **prepared runoff-proxy** difference within each stratum. Metadata uses the actual source units. No per-stratum runoff normalization is introduced.
* The optional caliper is a post-match acceptance threshold for every selected pair. A failing selected unconstrained optimum gives **threshold_not_met**, which does not prove that no full caliper-feasible assignment exists. No target is removed and no threshold is relaxed.
* Exact class/area equality and stratification do not imply equal continuous covariates, equal slope/routing/connectivity, or a causal treatment effect. Every unstratified dimension remains named. The chosen land-cover transition changes the original corresponding coefficients and retention assumptions together.
* Separate record IDs or titles are not independent spatial placements. Compare the saved mask SHA values and original chosen cell IDs. New analyst-defined sources or boundaries can produce another placement; deterministic renaming supplies no extra simulation evidence.
* The matching preparation computes no pollutant reduction. Annual native N/P kg/year and sediment tonnes/year remain the original model results, with original common-support comparisons. They are modeled delivery to streams, not intake concentrations.

## Saved states

| State | Meaning | Available continuation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| prepared | Every original treatment cell matched, all declared pair thresholds passed | Inspect, download, adopt original scenario/experiment, selected Study transfer |
| infeasible | Exact current support has missing/outside treatment cells or an exact stratum has fewer admissible candidates than targets | Inspect the complete assessment and adjust an explicitly authored new selection |
| threshold_not_met | The selected unconstrained optimum exceeds the declared caliper | Inspect every pair and make an explicit new design choice; no mathematical impossibility claim |
| Interrupted computation | No immutable design.json published yet; progress remains in the owned design directory | Retry the exact original request or author a new resource/selection edition |

Only prepared permits adoption. Failed scientific assessments are successful retained products: their original inputs, unmatched roster, statistics, complete CSV/JSON and HTML remain downloadable and are imported as ordinary OBSERVED_CONTEXT report sources.

## Original command line

Run from the actual application directory with its native GIS interpreter:

```sh
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli catalog --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli preview --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --selection AUTHORED_SELECTION.json
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli prepare --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --selection AUTHORED_SELECTION.json
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli inspect --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --id RETURNED_DESIGN_ID
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli adopt --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --id ACCEPTED_DESIGN_ID
PYTHON -B -m model.multivariate_control_cli execute --workspace ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE --id ADOPTED_DESIGN_ID
```

Execute is explicit; prepare and adopt do not execute native models. The queue uses the same functions through control.prepare, control.adopt and control.execute. Returned adoption identifies the exact original experiment, scenario, run, footprint and source collection. Use those returned IDs in the original Experiment/Programme controls; do not reconstruct native IDs or choose a default completed case.

Selection shape:

```json
{
  "schema": "upstate.multivariate-control-selection/v1",
  "title": "Author's named control design",
  "reason": "Author's scientific purpose and design rationale",
  "baseline_run_id": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_64_HEX_ID",
  "restoration_footprint_id": "ACTUAL_RETAINED_64_HEX_ID",
  "strata": [
    {"role": "DEM", "boundaries": [], "units": "m"}
  ],
  "precipitation_caliper": null,
  "exclusion_source": null,
  "max_working_bytes": 1073741824
}
```

This is a shape example, not an authored scientific design: the analyst must select original IDs, justified boundaries and a working-memory budget appropriate to the actual host. The empty boundaries explicitly impose no elevation constraint. No automatic quantiles, default thresholds, fabricated observations or silent optimizer substitutions are supplied.

For an optional source stratum use:

```json
{
  "role": "CONNECTIVITY",
  "boundaries": [],
  "units": "EXACT_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_UNITS",
  "definition": "The source's actual physical connectivity definition",
  "source": {
    "source_collection_id": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_64_HEX_ID",
    "source_id": "ACTUAL_SOURCE_ID",
    "source_sha256": "ACTUAL_ORIGINAL_64_HEX_SHA"
  }
}
```

The exclusion_source uses the same three source fields and a binary aligned band. Original source value1 excludes; zero admits; NoData does not admit a candidate. The original reporting mask still applies.

## Files and readable interpretation

The directory multivariate-controls/DESIGN_ID retains normalized selection, exact input binding and original records, original producer implementation, complete matching result, immutable assessment and source manifest. The normal report source contains all companions.

* report.html: directly usable offline complete assessment, with the exact declared boundaries/units/definitions, all strata and balance rows.

* matched-pairs.csv: every proposed pair, exact original row-major cell identities, coordinates, transition and each available physical value/residual.
* unmatched-targets.csv: original targets outside reporting support, missing selected covariates, or in insufficient candidate strata.
* strata.csv: full original-class/covariate roster, target/candidate/pair counts and reasons.

"""Continue one authored matched-control study in the original geographic receiver.

This module is called by receive_geographic_headwaters.py. Its direct entry point
only reopens an already restored study with the source contained in that archive.
Native design, matching, adoption and execution remain in model.multivariate_control.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(APP) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(APP))

from model.common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest, identifier, now, read_json, verify_file
from model.workspace import Workspace
from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import receiving_lock, _lock_identity

SCHEMA = "upstate.multivariate-control-receiving/v1"
REOPEN = "upstate.multivariate-control-cold-reopen/v1"
HELPER = "source_tools/multivariate_control_receiving.py"


def _event(stage, **details):
    print(json.dumps({"stage": stage, **details}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)


def _outside(path, root):
    if path == root or path.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(path):
        raise ValueError("Keep matched-control receiving output outside the application and Workspace")


def _original_runs(workspace):
    """Snapshot completed original records without inventing or changing a run."""
    records = []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / "runs").glob("*/run.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if value.get("state") == "complete":
            if value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
                raise ValueError("A completed original run changed its content identity")
            records.append({"id": value["id"], "selection": value["selection"],
                            "record": describe_file(workspace.root, path)})
    return records


def _preserve_original_runs(workspace, originals):
    for row in originals:
        path = verify_file(workspace.root, row["record"])
        value = read_json(path)
        if (value.get("id") != row["id"] or value.get("state") != "complete"
                or value.get("selection") != row["selection"]):
            raise ValueError("The matched-control continuation changed an original completed run")
    return {"completed_originals": len(originals), "identity": "MATCH"}


def _archive(workspace, output, selection):
    from model import study_transfer
    path = output / "matched-control-study.zip"
    receipt_path = output / "study-archive.json"
    if path.exists():
        inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(path, verify=True)
        if inspected["study"]["identity"]["selection"] != study_transfer.normalise(selection):
            raise ValueError("The retained archive belongs to another authored matched-control study")
        if inspected["manifest"]["project"] != workspace.project:
            raise ValueError("The retained archive belongs to another Workspace")
        if receipt_path.exists():
            receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
            if receipt["id"] != inspected["study"]["id"]:
                raise ValueError("The retained archive receipt changed its selected study")
            if receipt.get("sha256") != file_digest(path):
                raise ValueError("The retained selected Study ZIP differs from its original receipt")
            return receipt, inspected
        # An export can publish its complete archive before its caller saves the ACK.
        # Reconcile that exact original ZIP; never replace it with another selection.
        receipt = {"id": inspected["study"]["id"], "path": str(path),
                   "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(path),
                   "recovered_complete_archive": True}
    else:
        receipt = study_transfer.export_study(
            workspace, path, selection,
            progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-study-export", **value))
        inspected = study_transfer.inspect_transfer_archive(path, verify=True)
    atomic_json(receipt_path, receipt, immutable=True)
    return receipt, inspected


def _restore(output, archive, project):
    from model import portable
    destination = output / "received"
    receipt_path = output / "study-restore.json"
    if destination.exists():
        restored = portable.resume_restore(
            archive["path"], destination, expected_archive_sha256=archive["sha256"])
    else:
        restored = portable.restore(archive["path"], destination)
    if (restored["archive_sha256"] != archive["sha256"]
            or restored["project"] != project
            or Path(restored["application"]).resolve() != destination / "application"
            or Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve() != destination / "workspace"):
        raise ValueError("The received matched-control study changed its original archive or project")
    # Native resume may add its reconciliation status. Retain the first full receipt,
    # and keep the latest native reconciliation as a separate current result.
    if not receipt_path.exists():
        atomic_json(receipt_path, restored, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(output / "study-restore-current.json", restored)
    return restored


def _cold_reopen(restored, inspected, design, output, lock_fd, outcome=None):
    """Run the archive's own source in a clean Python process."""
    from source_tools.geographic_headwaters_reopen import _support
    support = _support()
    application = Path(restored["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
    workspace = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    members = inspected["manifest"]["members"]
    if "application/" + HELPER not in members:
        raise ValueError("The selected Study must include its original matched-control receiving chapter")
    source_identity = support._application(application, members)
    attempt = uuid.uuid4().hex
    directory = output / "cold-reopen" / attempt
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    request = {"schema": REOPEN, "attempt_id": attempt,
               "application": str(application), "workspace": str(workspace),
               "project": restored["project"], "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
               "study_id": inspected["study"]["id"], "design": design,
               **({"outcome": outcome} if outcome is not None else {}),
               "receiving_lock": _lock_identity(lock_fd, output / ".matched-control-receiving.lock")}
    request_path = directory / "request.json"
    result_path = directory / "result.json"
    atomic_json(request_path, request, immutable=True)
    request_sha = file_digest(request_path)
    command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(application / HELPER),
               "--reopen-request", str(request_path), "--request-sha256", request_sha,
               "--result", str(result_path), "--lock-fd", str(lock_fd)]
    atomic_json(directory / "launch.json",
                {"schema": REOPEN, "command": command, "started_at": now(),
                 "request_sha256": request_sha, "source_members": len(source_identity)},
                immutable=True)
    process = None
    try:
        with (directory / "stdout.log").open("xb", buffering=0) as stdout, \
                (directory / "stderr.log").open("xb", buffering=0) as stderr:
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=application, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                                       pass_fds=(lock_fd,))
            _event("matched-control-cold-process", pid=process.pid, command=command)
            code = process.wait()
            os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
            os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
        if code:
            raise RuntimeError("The contained matched-control application exited "
                               + str(code) + "; inspect " + str(directory / "stderr.log"))
        result = read_json(result_path)
        if (result.get("schema") != REOPEN or result.get("attempt_id") != attempt
                or result.get("request_sha256") != request_sha or result.get("identity") != "MATCH"
                or result.get("project") != restored["project"]
                or result.get("study_id") != inspected["study"]["id"]
                or result.get("design_id") != design["id"]
                or (outcome is not None and result.get("outcome_id") != outcome["id"])):
            raise ValueError("The contained application returned another saved design or Study")
        for name, identity in source_identity.items():
            if support._identity(support._member(application, name).lstat()) != identity:
                raise ValueError("The contained application source changed during cold reopening")
        return {**result, "attempt_directory": str(directory), "returncode": code,
                "stdout": str(directory / "stdout.log"), "stderr": str(directory / "stderr.log")}
    except BaseException:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        raise


def reopen(request_path, request_sha256, result_path, lock_fd):
    request_path = Path(request_path).resolve(strict=True)
    if file_digest(request_path) != identifier(request_sha256):
        raise ValueError("The cold-reopen request changed")
    request = read_json(request_path)
    if request.get("schema") != REOPEN or Path(request["application"]).resolve() != APP:
        raise ValueError("Use the source contained in the selected original Study archive")
    lock = request["receiving_lock"]
    if _lock_identity(lock_fd, lock["path"]) != lock:
        raise ValueError("The contained application lost the original receiving lock")
    workspace = Workspace(Path(request["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True))
    if workspace.project != request["project"]:
        raise ValueError("The contained Workspace is not the selected original project")
    from model import multivariate_control, study_transfer
    verification = study_transfer.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    if request["study_id"] not in {row["id"] for row in verification}:
        raise ValueError("The native selected-study receiver lost the original design root")
    found = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, request["design"]["id"])
    if found != request["design"]:
        raise ValueError("Cold reopening changed the retained design, adoption or native result")
    outcome = None
    if request.get("outcome") is not None:
        from model import multivariate_control_outcomes
        outcome = multivariate_control_outcomes.inspect(workspace, request["outcome"]["id"])
        if outcome != request["outcome"]:
            raise ValueError("Cold reopening changed the exact native outcome report, support or source")
    result = {"schema": REOPEN, "attempt_id": request["attempt_id"],
              "request_sha256": request_sha256, "project": workspace.project,
              "study_id": request["study_id"], "design_id": found["id"],
              **({"outcome_id": outcome["id"]} if outcome is not None else {}),
              "identity": "MATCH", "verified_studies": verification, "completed_at": now()}
    atomic_json(Path(result_path), result, immutable=True)
    return result


def _browser_admission(restored, study_id, design, outcome=None):
    """Pin the received native Study for the existing browser course."""
    root = Path(restored["workspace"]).resolve(strict=True)
    members = ["workspace.json", "study-transfers/" + identifier(study_id) + ".json",
               "multivariate-controls/" + identifier(design["id"]) + "/design.json"]
    if design.get("adoption"):
        members.append("multivariate-controls/" + design["id"] + "/adoption.json")
    if outcome is not None:
        members.append("multivariate-control-outcomes/" + identifier(outcome["id"]) + "/outcome.json")
    runs = []
    for path in sorted((root / "runs").glob("*/run.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
            raise ValueError("The received run differs from its original identifier")
        members.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
        runs.append({"id": value["id"], "state": value["state"]})
    return {"schema": "upstate.multivariate-control-browser-admission/v1",
            "project": restored["project"], "archive_sha256": restored["archive_sha256"],
            "application": restored["application"], "workspace": restored["workspace"],
            "study_id": study_id, "design_id": design["id"],
            **({"outcome_id": outcome["id"]} if outcome is not None else {}),
            "run_records": runs,
            "files": [describe_file(root, root / name) for name in members]}


def receive(workspace, output, *, selection_path=None, design_id=None, execute=False,
            prepared_id=None, outcome_selection_path=None):
    """Optional chapter of the maintained geographic receiving runner."""
    from model import multivariate_control, scenario_footprint, study_transfer
    if (selection_path is None) == (design_id is None):
        raise ValueError("Supply exactly one authored selection file or saved matched-control design ID")
    if type(execute) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("Choose explicitly whether to execute the new matched-control native case")
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    _outside(output, workspace.root)
    _outside(output, APP)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with receiving_lock(output / ".matched-control-receiving.lock") as lock_fd:
        if selection_path is not None:
            body = Path(selection_path).resolve(strict=True).read_bytes()
            selected = json.loads(body)
            atomic_bytes(output / "original-selection.json", body, immutable=True)
            proposed = multivariate_control.preview(workspace, selected)
            atomic_json(output / "preview.json", proposed)
            requested = {"selection_sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}
        else:
            requested = {"design_id": identifier(design_id)}
            selected = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)["selection"]
        outcome_requested = {}
        outcome_selection = None
        if outcome_selection_path is not None:
            body = Path(outcome_selection_path).resolve(strict=True).read_bytes()
            outcome_selection = json.loads(body)
            from model import multivariate_control_outcomes
            multivariate_control_outcomes.normalize(outcome_selection)
            atomic_bytes(output / "original-outcome-selection.json", body, immutable=True)
            outcome_requested["outcome_selection_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
        baseline = workspace.inspect_run(identifier(selected["baseline_run_id"]))
        footprint = scenario_footprint.get_footprint(
            workspace, identifier(selected["restoration_footprint_id"]))
        if baseline["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Receive a completed original baseline before a new control study")
        restoration = workspace.inspect_run(footprint["run_id"])
        if restoration["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Receive the completed original restoration used by this design")
        if prepared_id is not None:
            prepared_id = identifier(prepared_id)
            prepared = read_json(workspace.root / "geographic-headwaters" / prepared_id / "prepared.json")
            if (prepared["project_id"] != workspace.project["id"]
                    or prepared["id"] != prepared_id or prepared["baseline_run_id"] != baseline["id"]
                    or restoration["id"] not in prepared["alternative_run_ids"]):
                raise ValueError("The design does not use the selected original Geographic baseline and restoration")
        identity = {"schema": SCHEMA, "project_id": workspace.project["id"], **requested, **outcome_requested,
                    "prepared_id": prepared_id, "execute": execute,
                    "baseline_run_id": baseline["id"], "restoration_run_id": restoration["id"]}
        operation_id = digest(identity)
        state_path = output / "receiving.json"
        if state_path.exists():
            state = read_json(state_path)
            if state.get("identity") != identity or state.get("id") != operation_id:
                raise ValueError("Resume the same authored matched-control chapter in this output directory")
        else:
            state = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": operation_id, "identity": identity,
                     "original_completed_runs": _original_runs(workspace),
                     "created_at": now(), "stages": {}}
            atomic_json(state_path, state)

        def save(**value):
            state.update(value, updated_at=now())
            atomic_json(state_path, state)

        def phase(name, action):
            _preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"])
            started = time.perf_counter()
            save(state="running", active_stage=name)
            _event(name, operation_id=operation_id, state="running")
            try:
                result = action()
                _preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"])
            except BaseException as error:
                save(state="failed" if isinstance(error, Exception) else "interrupted",
                     error={"stage": name, "type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                raise
            previous = state["stages"].get(name, {})
            state["stages"][name] = {"state": "complete",
                "first_completed_at": previous.get("first_completed_at", now()),
                "first_elapsed_seconds": previous.get("first_elapsed_seconds", time.perf_counter()-started),
                "latest_elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started}
            state.pop("error", None)
            save(active_stage=None)
            return result

        if design_id is None:
            design = phase("matched-control-prepare",
                           lambda: multivariate_control.prepare(workspace, selected,
                               progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-design-progress", progress=value)))
            design_id = design["id"]
        else:
            design = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)
        save(design_id=design_id, design_state=design["state"])
        atomic_json(output / "design.json", design)
        if design["state"] == "prepared":
            adopted = phase("matched-control-adopt", lambda: multivariate_control.adopt(workspace, design_id))
            save(adoption=adopted["adoption"])
            if execute:
                def execute_control():
                    from model import experiments
                    result = multivariate_control.execute(workspace, design_id)
                    atomic_json(output / "native-experiment.json", result)
                    summary = experiments.read_summary(workspace, adopted["adoption"]["experiment_id"])
                    if summary is not None:
                        atomic_json(output / "native-summary.json", summary)
                    if result.get("state") != "complete":
                        raise ValueError("The original matched-control experiment is not complete; inspect its retained progress and resume this same chapter")
                    return result
                execution = phase("matched-control-native", execute_control)
                save(execution=execution)
        else:
            # Infeasible and threshold-rejected assessments are complete scientific
            # records. Export their full treatment/support evidence without adoption.
            save(interpretation="No accepted control design; the full original treatment remains retained.",
                 native_execution="not_adopted")
        design = multivariate_control.inspect(workspace, design_id)
        atomic_json(output / "design.json", design)
        outcome = None
        if outcome_selection is not None:
            if design_id not in outcome_selection["design_ids"]:
                raise ValueError("Include this exact original saved design in the authored outcome group")
            from model import multivariate_control_outcomes
            outcome_preview = phase("matched-control-outcome-preview",
                                    lambda: multivariate_control_outcomes.preview(workspace, outcome_selection))
            atomic_json(output / "outcome-preview.json", outcome_preview)
            originals = _original_runs(workspace)
            outcome = phase("matched-control-outcome-report",
                            lambda: multivariate_control_outcomes.prepare(workspace, outcome_selection,
                                progress=lambda value: _event("matched-control-outcome-progress", progress=value)))
            if _original_runs(workspace) != originals:
                raise ValueError("The native outcome report changed or added a completed model run")
            if outcome["id"] != outcome_preview["id"]:
                raise ValueError("The prepared outcome left the exact original preview")
            atomic_json(output / "outcome.json", outcome)
            save(outcome_report=outcome, outcome_id=outcome["id"])
        transfer_selection = {
            "schema": study_transfer.SELECTION_SCHEMA,
            "title": selected["title"] + " — editable matched-control study",
            "roots": [{"kind": "multivariate-controls", "id": design_id}]
                     + ([{"kind": "multivariate-control-outcomes", "id": outcome["id"]}] if outcome is not None else []),
            "include_related_results": True,
        }
        preview = phase("matched-control-study-preview",
                        lambda: study_transfer.preview(workspace, transfer_selection))
        atomic_json(output / "study-preview.json", preview)
        archive, inspected = phase("matched-control-study-export",
                                  lambda: _archive(workspace, output, transfer_selection))
        save(archive=archive, study_id=inspected["study"]["id"])
        restored = phase("matched-control-study-restore",
                         lambda: _restore(output, archive, workspace.project))
        save(restored=restored)
        cold = phase("matched-control-contained-reopen",
                     lambda: _cold_reopen(restored, inspected, design, output, lock_fd, outcome))
        save(state="complete", active_stage=None, design=design, independent_reopen=cold,
             browser_admission=_browser_admission(restored, inspected["study"]["id"], design, outcome),
             preserved_originals=_preserve_original_runs(workspace, state["original_completed_runs"]),
             outcome=design["state"],
             producer_view="Pending actual desktop/narrow operation and viewing of every outgoing attachment.")
        return state


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read-only contained matched-control Study reopening")
    parser.add_argument("--reopen-request", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--request-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--result", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--lock-fd", type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    result = reopen(args.reopen_request, args.request_sha256, args.result, args.lock_fd)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import ExitStack
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from .common import describe_file, verify_file
from . import rasters, receiving_waters as waters
from . import geographic_scenario_allocation as allocation
from . import geographic_siting_contrasts as siting

ROLES = ("baseline", "restoration", "control")
SUPPORTS = ("per_design", "group_common")
DEFINITIONS = {"per_design": "finite intersection of baseline, restoration and this control",
               "group_common": "finite intersection of baseline, restoration and every explicitly selected control"}
DIFFERENCES = ("baseline_minus_restoration", "baseline_minus_control", "control_minus_restoration")
PLACEMENT_METHOD = "window-addressed-final-categorical-change/v1"


def _read(source, window):
    import numpy as np
    data = source.read(1, window=window, masked=True)
    raw = np.ma.getdata(data)
    valid = ~np.ma.getmaskarray(data) & np.isfinite(raw)
    if np.any(valid & ((raw != np.floor(raw)) | (raw <= -2147483648) | (raw > 2147483647))):
        raise ValueError("The executed land-cover classes are not exact signed-int32 values")
    return raw, valid


def _same(left, right):
    import numpy as np
    return np.array_equal(left[1], right[1]) and np.array_equal(left[0][left[1]], right[0][right[1]])


def _mask_hash(hash_value, mask, window):
    import numpy as np
    address = [int(window.row_off), int(window.col_off), int(window.height), int(window.width)]
    hash_value.update(json.dumps(address, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii") + b"\n")
    hash_value.update(np.packbits(mask, bitorder="little").tobytes())


def _placement_hash(hash_value, baseline, alternative, changed, window):
    import numpy as np
    _mask_hash(hash_value, changed, window)
    hash_value.update(np.asarray(baseline[changed], dtype="<i4").tobytes())
    hash_value.update(np.asarray(alternative[changed], dtype="<i4").tobytes())


def _writer(stack, path, grid, *, units, quantity, mode, design, mask=False):
    import rasterio
    profile = rasters.output_profile(grid)
    profile.update(dtype="uint8" if mask else "float64", nodata=0 if mask else float("nan"),
                   predictor=1 if mask else 3, SPARSE_OK="YES")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    writer = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(path, "w", **profile))
    writer.update_tags(units=units, quantity=quantity, support_mode=mode,
        design_id=design, support_definition=DEFINITIONS[mode], method="original-native-float64-direct-difference/v1",
        outside_support="NoData; not zero", attribution="TokenJunkieLabs",
        interpretation="annual source-pixel export to streams; not concentration or intake load")
    return writer


def compute(ws, binding, directory, progress=None):
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from rasterio.windows import Window

    root = Path(directory)
    grid, members = binding["grid"], binding["members"]
    waters._validate_analysis_grid(grid)
    domain_rows, _ = rasters.vector_geometry(verify_file(ws.root, binding["grid_files"]["model_domain"]),
        layer="model_domain", target_crs=grid["crs"])
    model_domain = rasters.polygon_union(domain_rows)
    area = float(grid["pixel_area_ha"])
    baseline_id, restoration_id = binding["baseline_run_id"], binding["restoration_run_id"]
    run_ids = list(binding["runs"])
    quantity_names = binding["pollutants"]
    states = {(member["design_id"], mode): allocation._empty()
              for member in members for mode in SUPPORTS}
    for state in states.values():
        state["native_support"] = {p: {"native_common_cells": 0,
            "landcover_and_native_common_cells": 0, "valid_cells": dict.fromkeys(ROLES, 0),
            "restoration_changed_cells": 0, "control_changed_cells": 0} for p in quantity_names}
    placement_hashes = {run_id: hashlib.sha256((PLACEMENT_METHOD + "\n").encode("ascii"))
                        for run_id in run_ids if run_id != baseline_id}
    changed_counts = dict.fromkeys(placement_hashes, 0)
    reporting_changed_counts = dict.fromkeys(placement_hashes, 0)
    origin_counts = {run_id: {} for run_id in placement_hashes}
    overlaps = {(i, j): 0 for i in range(len(members)) for j in range(i + 1, len(members))}
    native_counts = {p: dict.fromkeys(run_ids, 0) for p in quantity_names}
    group_hashes = {p: hashlib.sha256(b"window-addressed-three-run-finite-native-mask/v1\n")
                    for p in quantity_names}
    group_counts = dict.fromkeys(quantity_names, 0)
    maps, mask_files, writers = [], [], {}
    total = math.ceil(grid["height"] / 256) * math.ceil(grid["width"] / 256)

    with ExitStack() as stack:
        categorical, originals, native_baseline = {}, {}, None
        for run_id, sources in binding["landcover"].items():
            source = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, sources["native"])))
            allocation._raster_grid(source, grid)
            if source.count != 1:
                raise ValueError("Original categorical case must retain one band")
            categorical[run_id] = source
            if sources.get("footprint"):
                original = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, sources["footprint"])))
                allocation._raster_grid(original, grid)
                if original.count != 1:
                    raise ValueError("Retained control footprint must have one band")
                originals[run_id] = original
            if sources.get("baseline_native"):
                native_baseline = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, sources["baseline_native"])))
                allocation._raster_grid(native_baseline, grid)
        mask = stack.enter_context(rasterio.open(verify_file(ws.root, binding["grid_files"]["reporting_mask"])))
        allocation._raster_grid(mask, grid)
        if mask.count != 1:
            raise ValueError("Original reporting mask must retain one band")
        bands = {}
        for run_id, quantities in binding["quantity_sources"].items():
            bands[run_id] = {}
            for pollutant, provenance in quantities.items():
                path = verify_file(ws.root / "runs" / run_id, provenance["artifact"])
                band = waters._aligned_source(stack, path, grid, factor=provenance["multiplier"],
                                              provenance=provenance)
                if band["source"].count != 1:
                    raise ValueError("Original native outcome must have one band")
                bands[run_id][pollutant] = band
        for index, member in enumerate(members, 1):
            key = member["design_id"]
            for mode in SUPPORTS:
                for pollutant in quantity_names:
                    prefix = "maps/design-" + str(index) + "/" + mode + "/" + pollutant
                    mask_name = prefix + "-support.tif"
                    writers[(key, mode, pollutant, "mask")] = _writer(stack, root / mask_name, grid,
                        units="mask", quantity=pollutant, mode=mode, design=key, mask=True)
                    mask_files.append({"design_id": key, "support_mode": mode, "support_definition": DEFINITIONS[mode], "pollutant": pollutant,
                                       "run_ids": run_ids if mode == "group_common" else [baseline_id, restoration_id, member["control_run_id"]],
                                       "path": mask_name})
                    for difference in DIFFERENCES:
                        name = prefix + "-" + difference + ".tif"
                        writers[(key, mode, pollutant, difference)] = _writer(stack, root / name, grid,
                            units=rasters.MASS_UNITS[pollutant], quantity=difference, mode=mode, design=key)
                        maps.append({"design_id": key, "design_index": index, "title": member["title"],
                            "support_mode": mode, "support_definition": DEFINITIONS[mode], "pollutant": pollutant, "difference": difference,
                            "run_ids": run_ids if mode == "group_common" else [baseline_id, restoration_id, member["control_run_id"]],
                            "units": rasters.MASS_UNITS[pollutant], "path": name})
        count = 0
        for top in range(0, grid["height"], 256):
            for left in range(0, grid["width"], 256):
                window = Window(left, top, min(256, grid["width"] - left), min(256, grid["height"] - top))
                blocks = {key: _read(source, window) for key, source in categorical.items()}
                for run_id, original in originals.items():
                    if not _same(blocks[run_id], _read(original, window)):
                        raise ValueError("Executed land cover differs from retained design footprint: " + run_id)
                if native_baseline is not None and not _same(blocks[baseline_id], _read(native_baseline, window)):
                    raise ValueError("Executed baseline differs from the original prepared categorical grid")
                report_data = mask.read(1, window=window, masked=True)
                report_valid = ~np.ma.getmaskarray(report_data)
                report_values = np.ma.getdata(report_data)
                if np.any(report_valid & ~np.isin(report_values, [0, 1])):
                    raise ValueError("Original reporting mask must contain only0/1")
                reporting = report_valid & (report_values == 1)
                inside = reporting if binding["quantity_scope"] == "reporting" else waters._inside(grid, model_domain, window)
                changed = {}
                for run_id in placement_hashes:
                    valid = blocks[baseline_id][1] & blocks[run_id][1]
                    change = valid & (blocks[baseline_id][0] != blocks[run_id][0])
                    changed[run_id] = change
                    changed_counts[run_id] += int(np.count_nonzero(change))
                    reporting_changed_counts[run_id] += int(np.count_nonzero(change & reporting))
                    _placement_hash(placement_hashes[run_id], blocks[baseline_id][0], blocks[run_id][0], change, window)
                    for code, n in zip(*np.unique(blocks[baseline_id][0][change].astype("int64"), return_counts=True)):
                        origin_counts[run_id][int(code)] = origin_counts[run_id].get(int(code), 0) + int(n)
                for (i, j) in overlaps:
                    overlaps[(i, j)] += int(np.count_nonzero(
                        changed[members[i]["control_run_id"]] & changed[members[j]["control_run_id"]]))
                values = {run_id: {p: waters._read_quantity(band, window) for p, band in selected.items()}
                          for run_id, selected in bands.items()}
                group_masks = {}
                for pollutant in quantity_names:
                    group = inside & np.logical_and.reduce([values[run_id][pollutant][1] for run_id in run_ids])
                    group_masks[pollutant] = group
                    group_counts[pollutant] += int(np.count_nonzero(group))
                    _mask_hash(group_hashes[pollutant], group, window)
                    for run_id in run_ids:
                        native_counts[pollutant][run_id] += int(np.count_nonzero(inside & values[run_id][pollutant][1]))
                for member in members:
                    key, control_id = member["design_id"], member["control_run_id"]
                    role_ids = {"baseline": baseline_id, "restoration": restoration_id, "control": control_id}
                    arrays = {role: blocks[run_id][0] for role, run_id in role_ids.items()}
                    valid = {role: blocks[run_id][1] for role, run_id in role_ids.items()}
                    for mode in SUPPORTS:
                        quantities = {p: {role: (values[run_id][p][0],
                            values[run_id][p][1] if mode == "per_design" else group_masks[p])
                            for role, run_id in role_ids.items()} for p in quantity_names}
                        masks = {p: {role: value[1] for role, value in original.items()}
                                 for p, original in quantities.items()}
                        allocation._accumulate(states[(key, mode)], arrays, valid, inside, masks, quantities, window)
                        for pollutant, original in quantities.items():
                            support = inside & np.logical_and.reduce([original[role][1] for role in ROLES])
                            writers[(key, mode, pollutant, "mask")].write(support.astype("uint8"), 1, window=window)
                            differences = {
                                "baseline_minus_restoration": original["baseline"][0] - original["restoration"][0],
                                "baseline_minus_control": original["baseline"][0] - original["control"][0],
                                "control_minus_restoration": original["control"][0] - original["restoration"][0]}
                            for difference, data in differences.items():
                                if np.any(~np.isfinite(data[support])):
                                    raise ValueError("The direct native mass difference exceeds finite Float64 range")
                                result = np.full(data.shape, np.nan, dtype="float64")
                                result[support] = data[support]
                                writers[(key, mode, pollutant, difference)].write(result, 1, window=window)
                count += 1
                if progress and (count % 16 == 0 or count == total):
                    progress({"stage": "native_outcome_comparison", "completed_windows": count,
                              "total_windows": total, "design_count": len(members)})
    # Check actual executed placement against the accepted complete design budgets.
    restoration_count = changed_counts[restoration_id]
    for member in members:
        control_id = member["control_run_id"]
        expected = member["summary"]["original_changed_cells"]
        if (changed_counts[control_id] != expected or restoration_count != expected
                or reporting_changed_counts[control_id] != expected
                or reporting_changed_counts[restoration_id] != expected
                or origin_counts[control_id] != origin_counts[restoration_id]):
            raise ValueError("Executed control changed its accepted complete area/original-class budget")
    regions = []
    for member in members:
        key = member["design_id"]
        ids = {"baseline": baseline_id, "restoration": restoration_id, "control": member["control_run_id"]}
        whole = {}
        for role in ("restoration", "control"):
            footprint = binding["landcover"][ids[role]]
            summary = footprint["summary"]
            if (summary["net_changed_cells"] != changed_counts[ids[role]]
                    or not math.isclose(summary["net_changed_hectares"], changed_counts[ids[role]] * area,
                                        rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-6)):
                raise ValueError("Actual executed placement differs from the retained footprint denominator")
            whole[role] = {"footprint_id": footprint["footprint_id"], "run_id": ids[role],
                          "cells": summary["net_changed_cells"], "hectares": summary["net_changed_hectares"],
                          "pixel_area_ha": area, "summary": deepcopy(summary),
                          "basis": "verified executed final categorical change from unchanged baseline"}
        siting_binding = {"whole_scenario_intervention": whole}
        for mode in SUPPORTS:
            state = states[(key, mode)]
            region = {"id": key + "-" + mode, "design_id": key, "title": member["title"],
                "kind": "whole_selection", "relationship": "original_" + binding["quantity_scope"],
                "quantity_scope": binding["quantity_scope"], "support_mode": mode,
                "support_definition": DEFINITIONS[mode], "run_ids": run_ids if mode == "group_common" else list(ids.values()),
                **allocation._finish(state, ids, area)}
            region["siting_contrasts"] = siting.finish(state["siting_contrasts"], region, area, siting_binding)
            for pollutant, outcome in region["siting_contrasts"].items():
                outcome["support_mode"] = mode
                outcome["support_definition"] = DEFINITIONS[mode]
                outcome["explicit_support_run_ids"] = run_ids if mode == "group_common" else list(ids.values())
                outcome["original_run_valid_cells"] = {role: native_counts[pollutant][run_id]
                                                       for role, run_id in ids.items()}
                if mode == "group_common":
                    if (outcome["native_common_cells"] != group_counts[pollutant]
                            or outcome["mask_sha256"] != group_hashes[pollutant].hexdigest()):
                        raise ValueError("One control lost the exact selected-roster common support")
                    outcome["explicit_common_run_ids"] = run_ids
            regions.append(region)
    # Common-group arithmetic must agree independently of the selected control.
    for pollutant in quantity_names:
        common_rows = [r["siting_contrasts"][pollutant] for r in regions if r["support_mode"] == "group_common"]
        first = common_rows[0]
        for member, item in zip(members, common_rows):
            own = next(r["siting_contrasts"][pollutant] for r in regions
                       if r["design_id"] == member["design_id"] and r["support_mode"] == "per_design")
            if (item["native_common_cells"] > own["native_common_cells"]
                    or item["mass"]["baseline"] != first["mass"]["baseline"]
                    or item["mass"]["restoration"] != first["mass"]["restoration"]
                    or item["alternatives"]["restoration"]["avoided_export_mass"] != first["alternatives"]["restoration"]["avoided_export_mass"]):
                raise ValueError("Selected-roster common-support arithmetic diverged across controls")
    placements = []
    seen = {}
    for index, member in enumerate(members, 1):
        control_id = member["control_run_id"]
        sha = placement_hashes[control_id].hexdigest()
        duplicate = seen.get(sha)
        seen.setdefault(sha, member["design_id"])
        placements.append({"design_id": member["design_id"], "index": index, "title": member["title"],
            "control_run_id": control_id, "control_footprint_id": member["control_footprint_id"],
            "placement_sha256": sha, "placement_method": PLACEMENT_METHOD,
            "same_placement_as": duplicate, "changed_cells": changed_counts[control_id],
            "changed_hectares": changed_counts[control_id] * area,
            "original_class_counts": origin_counts[control_id],
            "authored_selection": member["selection"], "balance": member["balance"]})
    overlap_rows = []
    for (i, j), count in overlaps.items():
        left, right = members[i], members[j]
        union = changed_counts[left["control_run_id"]] + changed_counts[right["control_run_id"]] - count
        overlap_rows.append({"left_design_id": left["design_id"], "right_design_id": right["design_id"],
            "intersection_cells": count, "intersection_hectares": count * area, "union_cells": union,
            "jaccard": count / union if union else None,
            "same_placement": placements[i]["placement_sha256"] == placements[j]["placement_sha256"]})
    for item in maps + mask_files:
        item["file"] = describe_file(root, root / item["path"])
    support = {p: {"native_common_cells": group_counts[p], "native_common_hectares": group_counts[p] * area,
                  "mask_sha256": group_hashes[p].hexdigest(), "run_ids": run_ids,
                  "individual_valid_cells": native_counts[p],
                  "unavailable_reason": "no_common_native_support" if not group_counts[p] else None}
               for p in quantity_names}
    return {"summary": {"design_count": len(members), "distinct_placements": len(seen),
            "duplicate_placements": len(members) - len(seen), "quantity_count": len(quantity_names),
            "quantity_scope": binding["quantity_scope"], "support_modes": list(SUPPORTS),
            "baseline_run_id": baseline_id, "restoration_run_id": restoration_id,
            "restoration_changed_cells": restoration_count, "restoration_changed_hectares": restoration_count * area,
            "group_common_support": support, "independent_replicates": None},
        "placements": placements, "placement_overlaps": overlap_rows, "regions": regions,
        "maps": maps, "support_maps": mask_files,
        "restoration_placement": {"sha256": placement_hashes[restoration_id].hexdigest(),
                                 "method": PLACEMENT_METHOD}}
files.model/multivariate_control_outcome_repor:
"""Readable original reports and map previews for retained control outcomes."""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
import csv
import html
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from .common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file
from . import scientific_report, scientific_figures, native_versions

LINKS = ("outcomes.csv", "partitions.csv", "placements.csv", "placement-overlaps.csv",
         "assessment.json", "selection.json", "input-binding.json", "report.pdf", "report.md", "report-data.json")


def _flat(value, prefix=""):
    result = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        name = prefix + key
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            result.update(_flat(item, name + "."))
        elif isinstance(item, list):
            result[name] = json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            result[name] = item
    return result


def _csv(path, rows):
    fields = list(dict.fromkeys(key for row in rows for key in row))
    with Path(path).open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=fields or ["no_rows"])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def _show(value):
    return "Unavailable" if value is None else format(value, ".7g") if isinstance(value, (float, int)) else str(value)


def _table(columns, rows, caption):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": columns, "rows": rows, "caption": caption}


def _figure(directory, name, spec, title, caption):
    from reportlab.graphics import renderSVG
    drawings = scientific_figures.panel_drawings(spec, 560)
    if len(drawings) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Outcome figure pages retain exactly one original panel")
    payload = renderSVG.drawToString(drawings[0])
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        payload = payload.encode("utf-8")
    atomic_bytes(Path(directory) / name, payload, immutable=True)
    return {"kind": "figure", **describe_file(directory, Path(directory) / name),
            "title": title, "alt": title + ". " + caption, "caption": caption, "spec": spec}


def _map_preview(directory, item, maximum, grid):
    """Bounded nearest-neighbour DISPLAY only; full Float64 GeoTIFF is authoritative."""
    import numpy as np
    import rasterio
    from rasterio.enums import Resampling
    directory = Path(directory)
    with rasterio.open(directory / item["path"]) as source:
        scale = max(source.width, source.height) / 128
        width = min(source.width, max(1, round(source.width / max(1, scale))))
        height = min(source.height, max(1, round(source.height / max(1, scale))))
        values = source.read(1, out_shape=(height, width), masked=True, resampling=Resampling.nearest)
        raw = np.ma.getdata(values)
        valid = ~np.ma.getmaskarray(values) & np.isfinite(raw)
        extent = list(source.bounds)
    sample = {"schema": "upstate.native-outcome-map-preview/v1", "original": item["file"],
        "design_id": item["design_id"], "pollutant": item["pollutant"], "units": item["units"],
        "support_mode": item["support_mode"], "support_definition": item["support_definition"],
        "run_ids": item["run_ids"], "crs": grid["crs"], "bounds": extent,
        "width": width, "height": height, "resampling": "nearest neighbour for display only",
        "legend_maximum": maximum,
        "values": [[float(raw[y, x]) if valid[y, x] else None for x in range(width)] for y in range(height)]}
    name = item["path"].removesuffix(".tif")
    atomic_json(directory / (name + ".preview.json"), sample, immutable=True)
    e = lambda text: html.escape(str(text), quote=True)
    plot_w = 640
    plot_h = max(1, round(plot_w * (extent[3] - extent[1]) / (extent[2] - extent[0])))
    cell_w, cell_h = plot_w / width, plot_h / height
    title = "Placement " + str(item["design_index"]) + " · " + item["pollutant"].replace("_", " ")
    parts = ['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 ' + str(plot_h + 180) + '" role="img">',
        "<title>" + e(title) + "</title><desc>Control minus restoration; group-common finite support. "
        "A nearest-neighbour display sample may omit small features; full original GeoTIFF retained.</desc>",
        '<defs><pattern id="nodata" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><rect width="6" height="6" fill="white"/><path d="M0 6L6 0" stroke="#b8b8b8" stroke-width=".7"/></pattern></defs>',
        '<rect width="720" height="' + str(plot_h + 180) + '" fill="white"/>',
        '<text x="40" y="25" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" fill="#17212b">' + e(title) + "</text>",
        '<text x="40" y="49" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12">Control minus restoration · ' + e(item["units"]) + "</text>",
        '<rect x="40" y="64" width="640" height="' + str(plot_h) + '" fill="url(#nodata)"/>']
    limit = maximum if maximum > 0 else 1.0
    for y in range(height):
        for x in range(width):
            if not valid[y, x]:
                continue
            fraction = min(1.0, abs(float(raw[y, x])) / limit)
            end = 40 if raw[y, x] < 0 else 235
            level = round(142 + fraction * (end - 142))
            colour = "#" + format(level, "02x") * 3
            parts.append('<rect x="' + format(40 + x * cell_w, ".3f") + '" y="' + format(64 + y * cell_h, ".3f") +
                         '" width="' + format(cell_w + .02, ".3f") + '" height="' + format(cell_h + .02, ".3f") +
                         '" fill="' + colour + '"/>')
    y = plot_h + 89
    for x, colour, label in [(40, "#282828", "Negative: restoration exports more"),
                             (330, "#ebebeb", "Positive: restoration exports less")]:
        parts += ['<rect x="' + str(x) + '" y="' + str(y-11) + '" width="12" height="12" fill="' + colour + '"/>',
            '<text x="' + str(x+18) + '" y="' + str(y) + '" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">' + label + "</text>"]
    parts += ['<text x="40" y="' + str(y+22) + '" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Shared legend ±' + e(_show(maximum)) + '; zero = middle gray; hatching = NoData.</text>',
        '<text x="40" y="' + str(y+43) + '" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Display sample only; original grid, bounds, CRS and full pixels are retained.</text>',
        '<text x="40" y="' + str(y+65) + '" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="10">TokenJunkieLabs · Original source/model quantities; scientist interpretation retained.</text></svg>']
    atomic_bytes(directory / (name + ".svg"), "".join(parts).encode("utf-8"), immutable=True)
    return {**item, "preview": describe_file(directory, directory / (name + ".svg")),
            "preview_data": describe_file(directory, directory / (name + ".preview.json"))}



def guide_links(binding):
    result, seen = [], set()
    for models in binding["native_execution"]["runs"].values():
        for model, info in models.items():
            url = native_versions.guide_url(model, info)
            if url and url not in seen:
                seen.add(url)
                result.append({"title": model.upper() + " methods and units · " +
                               native_versions.version_label(info), "url": url})
    return result


def source_sections(directory, sections):
    """Use the maintained observed-source figure companion contract."""
    result, figures, choices = [], [], []
    for heading, blocks in sections:
        copied = []
        for block in blocks:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "figure":
                key = Path(block["path"]).stem
                figure = {**deepcopy(block["spec"]), "id": key, "title": block["title"],
                          "caption": block["caption"]}
                scientific_figures._validate_figure(figure)
                figures.append(figure)
                choices.append({"id": key, "path": block["path"]})
                copied += [block["caption"], {"kind": "links", "items": [
                    {"title": block["title"], "path": block["path"]}]}]
            else:
                copied.append(deepcopy(block))
        result.append([heading, copied])
    if not figures:

    name = "scientific-figures.json"
    atomic_json(Path(directory) / name,
                {"schema": "upstate.scientific-figure-spec/v1", "figures": figures}, immutable=True)
    return result, {"figure_spec": name, "figures": choices}


def write(directory, assessment, notes):
    root = Path(directory)
    selected, binding = assessment["selection"], assessment["binding"]

    for region in assessment["regions"]:

                      "support_mode": region["support_mode"], "support_definition": region["support_definition"],
                      "quantity_scope": region["quantity_scope"], "pollutant": pollutant,
                      "run_ids": json.dumps(region["run_ids"], separators=(",", ":"))}
            outcomes.append({**prefix, **_flat(result)})
            for role, alternative in result["alternatives"].items():
                for partition, value in alternative["source_cell_partitions"].items():

    _csv(root / "partitions.csv", partitions)

    all_maps = [{"title": "Placement " + str(m["design_index"]) + " · " + m["support_mode"] + " · " +

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from .workspace import Workspace
from . import multivariate_control_outcomes as controls
from .common import read_json


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("operation", choices=("catalog", "preview", "prepare", "inspect", "files"))
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--selection", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--id")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.operation in ("preview", "prepare"):
        if not args.selection or args.id:
            parser.error("Preview/prepare require --selection and no --id")
    elif args.operation != "catalog":
        if not args.id or args.selection:
            parser.error("Inspect/files require --id and no --selection")
    elif args.id or args.selection:
        parser.error("Catalog takes only the original --workspace")
    ws = Workspace(args.workspace)
    if args.operation == "catalog":
        value = controls.catalog(ws)
    elif args.operation == "preview":
        value = controls.preview(ws, read_json(args.selection))
    elif args.operation == "prepare":
        value = controls.prepare(ws, read_json(args.selection),
            progress=lambda row: print(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False), file=sys.stderr, flush=True))
    else:
        value = getattr(controls, args.operation)(ws, args.id)
    print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
